purpose: Kunwei K raw frame to UR TCP/tool frame gravity-axis calibration
safety: No robot motion is commanded by this script.
No UR RTDE inputs are written.
No UR zero_ftsensor call is made.
No Kunwei zero/tare/config command is sent.
Kunwei stream start/stop commands are sent unless disabled by CLI flags.

segments.name: P1_wrist3_plus_90
segments.operator_action: rotate only wrist3 +90 deg from P0; hold still

segments.name: P2_wrist3_plus_180
segments.operator_action: rotate only wrist3 +180 deg from P0; hold still

segments.name: P3_wrist3_plus_270
segments.operator_action: rotate only wrist3 +270 deg from P0; hold still

segments.name: P4_return_P0
segments.operator_action: return wrist3 to P0; hold still
